purpose: tie-bias audit of the shipped LOO-quantile index shift vs the physical multiset-trim gold standard

fuzz.note: when the shipped theta is LOWER than the physical-LOO theta the control fires MORE (B2B FPR over-stated = G5-conservative); when HIGHER, FPR under-stated (G5-anti-conservative)

shipped.note: p3-null q=0.98 family-pool floor=0.0; theta convention = shipped multiset-trim

physical.note: p3-null q=0.98 family-pool floor=0.0; theta convention = physical multiset-trim

theta_agreement.note: direction of the shipped theta relative to the physical-LOO theta (lower = over-fire = G5-conservative; higher = under-fire = G5-anti-conservative)
